proposals.evidence: CDIAL4780 explicitly gives European Romani čik mud, dirt, clay, ashes. Link Zargari cik to this Indo-Aryan cikka family. Turner discusses competing Dravidian/Munda origins of the older family; this does not establish a direct Zargari borrowing from either, and no such donor claim is made.
